string.text: Gas outlet modification
The modified gas outlet allows for an increase in the initial velocity of the bullet while reducing recoil.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets, which has a beneficial effect on the accuracy of firing.
Changing the barrel cutting pitch
Increases the initial speed of the bullet, due to which the bullet deviates less from the expected trajectory and reaches the target faster.Useful for long range shooting.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to internal parts helps slow down the wear of the weapon.
Tactical flashlight

A narrowly focused, long-range flashlight is indispensable in night forays, as well as when exploring and clearing dark rooms.Does not interfere with the installation of a laser pointer and can be used in conjunction with it.
Rail fastening

Replacing the gas outlet cover with a plastic one with Piccatiny-type rails allows you to equip the weapon with various tactical equipment (including laser sights, tactical flashlights and additional types of sights).
Anatomical handle
Provides the right hand with a more comfortable grip.
Heavy Duty Parts
Replacing standard parts with analogues made of high-strength alloys makes it possible to increase the wear resistance of weapons.
Laser pointer

Visually indicates the location of the intended hit on the target, greatly facilitating and speeding up aiming, as well as having a demoralizing effect on the victim.Does not interfere with the installation of a tactical flashlight and can be used in conjunction with it.
Modification of the cartridge supply unit
Refinement of the ammunition supply unit makes it possible to reduce the number of delays associated with non-feeding and misalignment of the cartridge.
Rate of fire retarder

Allows you to make shooting more stable by reducing the spread of bullets, and contributes to more economical consumption of ammunition.It also reduces the heating of the barrel, which has a beneficial effect on the life of the weapon.
Light alloy parts

Replacing parts in the main components of the weapon with their light-alloy counterparts makes it possible to reduce the weight of the weapon without significant harm to its other tactical and technical characteristics.
Improved backplate
Installing a soft rubberized butt plate reduces the felt recoil from shots fired by the shooter.
Lightweight stock
Allows you to reduce the weight of weapons.
Improved cutoff
Modification of the cartridge ejection system reduces the likelihood of delays during shooting due to the cartridge case sticking after the shot.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Tactical grip
Installing an under-barrel grip allows you to make the weapon more convenient to handle, making it easier to compensate for recoil.
Forcing USM
Refinement of the firing mechanism components makes it possible to increase the weapon's rate of fire, unfortunately, at the cost of some reduction in reliability.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Recoil compensator
An improved recoil compensator integrated into the barrel significantly reduces the felt recoil from a weapon shot and makes shooting more comfortable.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing, and also reduces the likelihood of delays when firing.
Chamber adjustment
Allows you to improve obturation and achieve higher shooting accuracy.
High capacity magazine (black, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (brown, 45 rounds)
Allows you to reduce the number of reloads in battle, increasing your chances of staying alive.
High capacity magazine (60 rounds)
Allows you to send even more opponents to the best of two worlds with one burst.
